title: Dietary needs
old_caption: Cancer asked for dietary needs and got yes, spicy, something new and a spreadsheet. The real question: their partner's family recipe. Virgo: ask them to teach you. Who in your chat would try the surprise anyway?

title: Best moment
old_caption: Leo asked for everyone's best moment of the year and the chat brought callbacks. Aries said it was a bad year for love. Virgo said learning what you want counts. What did your year teach you?

title: Why so quiet?
old_caption: The group chat went quiet for hours. Pisces got worried. Everyone was at the same table, Pisces included. The bread burnt and nobody cared. Who would you put down your phone for?

title: Delivered, 7:02 PM
old_caption: Delivered at 7:02. Silent until 3 a.m. Eleven friends, one agenda, zero double texts, and a phone that had simply died. Who in your chat reads the silence out loud?

title: The Situationship Summit
old_caption: Four months of just vibing, one emergency summit, and a toothbrush that was not a coincidence. Scorpio asked plainly. Who would chair the summit in your group chat?

title: Taurus at the Holiday Table
old_caption: The aunt asked. Taurus froze mid-bite, asked her back, and walked away with a whole love story and three containers of leftovers. Who at your table needs the reverse question?

title: Liked a Photo From Three Years Ago
old_caption: 1:41 a.m. One thumb, one heart, one photo from three years ago. The chat went CODE RED, then let Cancer say what they actually miss. Who is your 2 a.m. emergency contact?

title: The Advice Desk Is Closed
old_caption: Virgo answered 41 questions tonight and left their own text unanswered since 2:04 PM. So the chat quoted Virgo back, word for word. Which friend never asks for help?

title: They Ended It
old_caption: 7 p.m.: they ended it. By 3 a.m. there was soup in a car seat, the worst date story ever told and twelve people on a very quiet call. Tag the friend who stays on the call.

title: Four Hours to Say It
old_caption: Four hours to tell the best friend. Forty minutes lost to black holes. One breadstick eaten in fear. The ending, though. Who in your chat should say it before midnight?
